# Quaternius Universal Animation Library

Source: https://store.godotengine.org/asset/quaternius/universal-animation-library/

Imported files:
- `AnimationLibrary_Unity_Standard.fbx`
- `Unity_Setup.png`
- `License.txt`

License: CC0 1.0 Universal.

The current enemy models use procedural motion in `EnemyVisual` because their rig/avatar does not match this animation library yet. Use this FBX as the source animation library when adding a retargeted AnimatorController.
